catalog.source: SELECT id, sku, name, priceCents, stock FROM items ORDER BY name

search-items.source:
SELECT i.id, i.name, i.stock FROM items i
WHERE mantle.search(i, input.q)
ORDER BY mantle.search_rank(i), i.name

my-orders.source:
SELECT o.id, o.qty, o.orderStatus, i.name AS item, o.version
FROM orders o JOIN items i ON i.id = o.itemId
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC

sales-by-item.source:
SELECT i.name, count(o.id) AS orders, coalesce(sum(o.qty), 0) AS units
FROM items i LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.itemId = i.id AND o.orderStatus = 'placed'
GROUP BY i.name
ORDER BY units DESC, i.name

recent-activity.source: SELECT kind, subject, detail FROM activity ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50

place-order.title: Place an order
place-order.description: Order one item for the signed-in caller; the stock check fails the whole order when stock runs out.

handler.source:
INSERT INTO orders (itemId, qty, orderStatus, placedAt)
SELECT id, input.qty, 'placed', now() FROM items WHERE id = input.itemId
RETURNING id, qty, orderStatus;
UPDATE items SET stock = stock - input.qty WHERE id = input.itemId

restock.title: Restock an item
restock.description: Add stock to an item by SKU, creating the item if it is new.

handler.source:
INSERT INTO items (sku, name, stock) VALUES (input.sku, input.name, input.qty)
ON CONFLICT (sku) DO UPDATE SET stock = items.stock + EXCLUDED.stock
RETURNING id, sku, stock
